answer: Each identity binds one registered apiary: hives and a colony health certificate filed under its key, the registry following one ownership thread from hive tag to key and rejecting a second identity on the same apiary. Weight unlocks only after the colony survives a 180-day season and passes a check of its pulse — brood and foraging — while a smoker's ember calms the bees. Per fake: 1,200 units in fees, two hives at 800 units, 180 days; 100 fakes cost 280,000 units and 18,000 days. Cheapest cheat: buying a ready apiary for ~3,000 units, but the seller surrenders its own backing.
